whenToUse: The value has a fixed format, such as an email or phone number.
You flag missing required fields before submitting.
You explain input rules up front, such as password rules.
whenNotToUse: You'd show an error on every keystroke before people finish typing.
The error has nothing to do with a specific field, such as a server outage.
The message gives no fix, such as "Invalid input".

alternatives.name: Alert Banner
alternatives.reason: An error for the whole form or the system.

alternatives.name: Toast
alternatives.reason: A result such as a successful submission.

accessibility: Connect a <label> to the field and don't use the placeholder in place of a label.
On error, set aria-invalid and connect the hint and the error message with aria-describedby.
Make the error area aria-live so new errors are read out.
Show errors with an icon and words, not color alone, and say how to fix them.
